{{DISPLAYTITLE:Source:Letter to Carolyn F., 10 June 1994}}

ROBERT JORDAN

c\o Tor Books

175 Fifth Avenue

New York, N.Y., 10010

June 10, 1994

Ms. Carolyn Fusinato



Dear Carolyn:

Thanks for your letter of May 21, and for the copies of The Chronicles, which I enjoyed very much. Please keep them coming. 
Your take on the prophecies is interesting. Hmmmm.

Oh my dear, I do hope there will not be ten books all told. I'm planning for eight, at present, and hope very strongly that I can wrap it all up in that length. 
Enjoy your vacation!

Best Regards,

Robert Jordan

RJ: kb-n
